content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have an issue with my [product_name] [version_no]. I've enabled the web server and installed the [company_name] [product_name] App on my iPhone. The app connects, and I see the controller status, but I am unable to control variables. I added a variable in the app with address v0.1, and also added an Input Network variable with the same address in the program, yet I cannot add this variable to the Variable Memory table (VM). The VM table does not allow selection or manual entry of variables. When I try to change a value through the app, the change is not reflected in the program. I've read the [product_name] software documentation, but still do not understand what is wrong. Any help would be appreciated.
In your screenshot, you have assigned VM address V2.0 to NI1 and NI2. That configuration is incorrect.
The address in the screenshot is just meant as an example of my problem.
Even if it's just an example, the addresses should not be the same. Each address must be unique.
Yes, I reviewed the [document] but I'm still unsure about the configuration process.
Hello [user_name], please review the attached material. If anything is unclear, feel free to ask questions.

Hi, I believe my lack of experience is causing difficulty in locating the "log off" or "web server" page as shown in your previous message. What steps do I need to take? Also, I am struggling to find any information about Remote TSAP.
Could you clarify what you are referring to exactly?
The first page from the attachment at [url] is what I cannot figure out how to access. I also can't locate the Remote TSAP information.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble configuring variable memory and remote control features in [product_name] [version_no] using the [company_name] app and web server. Common issues include incorrect address assignments, inability to find configuration options such as web server pages and TSAP settings, and difficulty syncing changes between the app and controller.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily set up and control variable memory from the app, see variable changes reflected in the [product_name] device, and have straightforward access to configuration elements like web server setup and remote TSAP.
